# Contributing to pdfmake

Thank you for your interest in contributing to pdfmake!

## Issues

Use GitHub issues to report bugs, suggest features, or discuss improvements.
Please search existing issues before opening a new one.

When reporting a bug, include:

- The pdfmake version you are using.
- A description of the expected and actual behavior.
- A minimal reproducible example that runs in the
  [playground](http://pdfmake.org/playground.html),
  [JSFiddle](https://jsfiddle.net/), or a similar service.

If the issue only occurs in Node.js, provide a minimal runnable script
and specify your Node.js version.

## Security and sensitive reports

For security vulnerabilities or other sensitive issues that should not be disclosed
publicly, please contact the maintainer privately using the e-mail address listed on
[liborm85's GitHub profile](https://github.com/liborm85).

## Pull requests

Keep each pull request focused on a single fix or improvement,
and explain what it changes and why.

- Only modify `package.json` when necessary for your changes.
- Use an editor with [EditorConfig](https://editorconfig.org/) support
  to follow the project's code style.
- Avoid unrelated formatting changes.
- Add or update tests where appropriate.
